llmResponse.agenda_changes: At the beginning of the meeting, President DS Locum asked "Are there any changes to the agenda this evening?" Trustee Marquez proposed moving items 10.5, 10.6, and 10.7 to consent, and also proposed moving items 10.3 and 10.4 to consent. This was seconded and approved (all in favor said "Aye").
llmResponse.consent_vote_words: Moving right along to the bond program consent items. Recommendation regarding approval of bundle program consent items. Recommendation of approval measure T, bond program tracking list of items, and recommendation of approval of the MUB transfer switch installation proposal for various sites. Do I have a motion to approve all those three? Cecilia and second. Mike, all those in favor?
